main:3.text: After helping the police take down the Kingpin, Peter gets a call from his boss at work that they need to run an equipment check and that The Grant Committee is coming. Peter then tells his boss that he's on his way and will be there soon. Once inside, Peter finds Dr. Otto Octavius—the head of Octavius Industries, a small independent company that specializes in developing prostheses—in the middle of a demonstration.

main:4.text: Yuri calls Spider-Man shortly after he leaves Dr. Otto Octavius' lab, requesting to meet him at the Police Department rooftop. While swinging there, Spider-Man listens to a podcast by J. Jonah Jameson, in which Jameson berates a plumber who calls in defending Spider-Man and praising him for defeating Wilson Fisk, by retorting that Spider-Man defeating a mob boss will just lead to three taking Fisks' place.

main:8.page: For She's a Jolly Good Fellow
main:8.text: After receiving a call from Martin Li, Peter Parker heads towards F.E.A.S.T., a homeless shelter. Along the way, he receives a call from his landlord informing him he is on his third and final warning to pay rent, and that eviction proceedings begin soon. Parker enters F.E.A.S.T., a homeless shelter, and speaks to him, apologizing for being late. Martin Li shrugs and asks Peter to distract Aunt May.

main:9.text: Spider-Man receives a call from Yuri to investigate a silent alarm triggered at Fisk's estate while at F.E.A.S.T., and leaves in a hurry. On his way there, Aunt May calls him, thanking him for his heartfelt words from earlier. Spider-Man entered through a back entrance in the roof.

main:10.text: Yuriko Watanabe calls Spider-Man to inform him that Herman Schultz, the Shocker, has violated parole again, prompting Spider-Man to swing over to stop him. On the way, Dr.

main:11.text: The Mask is the eleventh main mission in Marvel's Spider-Man. Spider-Man travels to catch up with Martin Li in order to get information on the Inner Demons mask. After catching Shocker, Spider-Man receives a call from Mary Jane Watson, who asks him to learn more about the mask the two recovered during "Don't Touch the Art". Spider-Man says he intends to ask Martin Li, who has a degree in Art History. On the way, J.

main:12.text: Peter Parker arrives to witness Otto working with Lance Corporal James Texidor. Just as success is realized, Mayor Norman Osborn enters with an order to shut the site down due to "hazardous conditions", explaining the grant came with strict safety violations.

main:13.text: Harry's Passion Project is the thirteenth main mission in Marvel's Spider-Man. The mission introduces players to Harry Osborn's research stations scattered throughout the city, a dream he carried out for his mother; accessing these rewards Research Tokens. After Otto Octavius' lab is shut down by Norman Osborn, Peter Parker thinks to contact Harry for help, before dismissing the idea.

main:15.text: Wheels within Wheels is the fifteenth main mission in Marvel's Spider-Man. Spider-Man receives a call from Yuriko Watanabe, who says she has been investigating the Inner Demons attacking Wilson Fisk properties. They narrow it down to a shipyard under heavy guard by snipers. Yuriko calls Spider-Man to inform him that the Inner Demons have been attacking Fisk properties.

main:17.text: After arriving at the waypoint, look through the camera until the zoom upon is unlocked, then zoom in left to a warehouse atop a building, where a shine from a black cat object can be found. Take its photo to complete the mission. From here out, players can track down the Black Cat statues to uncover her mystery and unlock a custom suit. The next mission, "Couch Surfing", begins shortly after.

main:18.text: Once Peter arrives at May's couch at the shelter, he quickly falls asleep. He finds Aunt May at her desk in the morning, and she has left him cash to help. Peter initially can't accept, but May insists, telling him he is much like his uncle Ben Parker and must swallow the "Parker pride" and ask for help next time.

main:20.text: The mission is the first time in the game that the player controls Miles Morales as Peter Parker is unconscious for the mission's duration. Peter Parker hurries to meet up with MJ at the ceremony for Jefferson Davis, who arrives with his family, consisting of his wife, Rio Morales, and his son, Miles Morales.

main:21.text: Mary Jane Watson calls Peter Parker with a tip about Li and a recycling business he bought a controlling interest in. She also reveals what the arrested Inner Demons have said about Li – that he brings out the "negative" side of people so they do things they normally would not do. Upon entering the building, Spider-Man finds a map that appears to target all of the campaign offices of Norman Osborn.

main:22.text: While there as Peter Parker, he suggests to Aunt May that Miles Morales might be a good person to hire. He then decides to search Li's office, entering through the ventilation duct as the door was locked. There, Peter finds a note written to May in which he expressed genuine belief in F.E.A.S.T.'s mission, but also warned her that he would be written about as a criminal.

main:24.text: Peter arrives at Mary Jane's apartment to cook dinner, having promised it to her earlier when he called her after finding the Devil's Breath file in Martin Li's office at the F.E.A.S.T. shelter. Upon arriving, Mary Jane lets Peter know that she went to the address of one of Martin Li's properties earlier in the day, handing Peter a GPS tracker she recovered.

main:27.text: Spider-Man managed to get the name "Dr. Isaac Delaney" from Charles Standish before Sable International stepped in. After passing this information onto Mary Jane Watson, she dug into it while Spider-Man investigated a box at the request of Yuriko Watanabe.

main:29.text: Uninvited is the twenty-ninth main mission in Marvel's Spider-Man. When discussing what he has learned about Devil's Breath with Mary Jane Watson, Peter Parker learns from her that Charles Standish is being held by Sable International. Mary Jane tells Peter that Charles Standish may know where Morgan Michaels is, and indicates she is going to try to sneak in to meet Standish.

main:33.text: The One That Got Away is the thirty-third main mission in Marvel's Spider-Man. Yuriko Watanabe calls Spider-Man to give him a lead on Martin Li's location. Meanwhile, Mary Jane Watson is at Grand Central Station, and encounters Martin Li as he attempts to release Devil's Breath.

main:34.text: Once Peter arrives, he finds that the Doctor has already utilized an intra-cranial neural network to attach and use his prosthetic arms, giving him neuro-transmission speeds under one nanosecond, faster than signals traveling inside the brain. When Peter examines the interface, he notices there are errors with cascading voltage spikes in the motor complex, doubting if he can fix it.

main:37.text: Quarantine is the thirty-seventh main mission in Marvel's Spider-Man. Doctor Octopus arrives in Times Square with the Devil's Breath and he disperses it onto the city. The Devil's Breath makes almost everyone in New York City and the whole city goes in quarantine. In just 24 hours, Aunt May also catches the plague.

main:38.text: Yuri calls Spider-Man requesting urgent help for her officers. She then requests Spider-Man take out either Rhino or Electro. On the way there, Aunt May calls to tell Spider-Man that men from Ryker's are at the F.E.A.S.T.'s sister office, the Veteran's Center, ransacking it and demanding supplies.

main:39.text: Yuri calls Spider-Man to let him know the department cannot do a forensics sweep of Times Square because everyone is sick. There, Spider-Man follows a dispersal trial into Doctor Octopus's lair.

main:41.text: With Scorpion's poison wearing off, Peter Parker decides it is a good time to visit Aunt May. Once there, she appears to be sick. Peter attempts to contact Miles Morales, who has been sent to retrieve more medical supplies from the relief center. Miles, at the waterfront, steals antibiotics from convicts.

main:42.text: After hearing from Miles Morales following his own encounter with Rhino at the relief center, Spider-Man contacts Yuriko Watanabe and lets her know that Rhino is targeting relief centers throughout the city. She directs him to where Rhino likely is: Harlem.

main:43.text: Mary Jane Watson calls Peter Parker to let him know she has not found the location of the Devil's Breath lab. As it was not in the city, state, or federal databases, she suspects the lab is off the books and that its location may be in Norman Osborn's penthouse. With it full of Sable International soldiers, she thinks she has a better chance of sneaking in and avoiding a firefight than Spider-Man.

main:44.text: Spider-Man heads off to retrieve the antiserum. Along the way, Spider-Man calls Yuriko Watanabe to tell her he is finding the cure. Yuri then informs him that a helicopter just went down at the address of the secret lab. Mister Negative has captured Norman, and his Inner Demons patrol the ground and rooftops outside. Spider-Man defeats them. Sable International troops arrive and attack Spider-Man.

main:45.text: Accessing the lab at this point is the last chance players have to upgrade their suit and abilities until the end of the story. In this mission, players will be locked wearing Anti-Ock Suit and its associated suit power. When the game ends, the player will go back to the suit they wore prior to starting the mission.

side:1.text: This mission is unlocked by completing the repairs on the surveillance towers for Yuriko Watanabe. It takes place in the Financial District. There are three devices to find and destroy, each with a group of Fisk's men. The second tower will include additional thugs on a separate rooftop with long-range rifles and laser scopes. These will need to be eliminated as well.

side:2.text: The mission starts in the Upper East Side district and becomes available after completing the mission Keeping the Peace. The majority of the mission takes place in Central Park. This mission occurs at night, so the game will pause to change the time of day. Approach Belvedere Castle, and Spider-Man notices several of Wilson Fisk's men, all armed.

side:3.text: The mission is unlocked after capturing Shocker in the story mission A Shocking Comeback. It takes place at night. After arriving at the Detox center, find a good hidden location, preferably a perch atop a lamppost with a view of her face, and take the woman's picture. After this, she leaves in a vehicle and meets up with another person.

side:4.text: The mission is unlocked after completing the story mission "The Mask". Spider-Man finds a local business owner who thanks him for saving his daughter. Confused, Spider-Man looks to the crime scene to investigate, seeing a cop along with some beaten thugs. The owner's daughter, present at the scene, asks why he is still there and not off to stop the nearby fire.

side:7.text: The mission it is unlocked after completing the story mission "Couch Surfing". Spider-Man talks to a woman at a rooftop who asks him about the "Screwball challenge", asking him to take a photo of a QR code. After doing so, Spider-Man calls him and welcomes her to the stream which she claims is surging in followers with his presence.

side:8.text: The mission begins at Octavius Industries in Greenwich. Interacting with the transmitter in the lab will begin a puzzle to solve. An image of the solved connections is in the gallery below. Once the transmitter is repaired, exit the laboratory. Spider-Man can track what it leads to. Use the radar on the left side of the screen to narrow down the location. It will eventually lead to a cargo truck.

side:9.page: Tombstone: What's He Building in There...
side:9.text: Beginning at the mission area are several armed guards. Some can be taken down with sneak attacks if desired. The largest group of Tombstone's gang are near the front, unloading the truck. It might be easier to pick off others in the gang by stealth prior to engaging the larger group. Look for a few near lampposts, north of the main entrance. A few others are near shipping containers.

side:10.text: The side mission is a boss battle with Tombstone. Tombstone can be attacked with melee moves and Finishers. After beating on Tombstone for a while, he will call in his thugs. They will need to be defeated, then Tombstone is weakened a bit more before the counter-drug can be used, which will happen automatically. After the counter-drug takes effect, Tombstone will be more vulnerable to attacks.

side:11.text: Phillip Chang, an Empire State University student, has been missing his roommate Carlos since the Halloween party. The only information he has is a photograph taken somewhere near the Statue of Liberty in the south end of the Financial District. He offers it to Spider-Man via a text. Head to the south end of the Financial District, near the water. Follow the waypoint to the location.

side:12.text: The image shows the elevated train tracks in East Harlem. As you head for the area, Phillip will mention Carlos from the previous missing student mission. Apparently Carlos got sick after the Halloween party – a delayed reaction. When Spider-Man is close to the area, he will find witnesses to talk to. One will mention maniacs up the street.

side:13.text: This mission takes place at night. Talk to Phillip Chang to get started. Steven Hopkins is missing, but Phillip is concerned because some of Tombstone's gang started dealing drugs in Steven's neighborhood recently. Steve hated it but was too scared to do anything, but since he is possibly corrupted currently, he may have reacted and attacked them.

side:14.text: Phillip Chang needs Spider-Man's help once more. This time the entire Debate Club is missing. Phillip's internet search revealed a photograph that includes the club's president Henry near the Brooklyn Bridge. At the scene, Spider-Man finds several corrupted students whacking at a truck's leaking gas load with crowbars and baseball bats.

side:15.text: According to Phillip, the college football team went on to an away game and never came back. The buses were found completely abandoned. The latest of Phillip's photos shows an image of the quarterback Brad Davis near Washington Square Arch, just south of Empire State University. At the location, several corrupted students are brawling with cops and civilians.

side:16.text: The courthouse is the first of four sniper locations. Taking out the first sniper will unlock the rest and start a two minute, thirty second timer. This basically becomes a race around the city as the first three sniper take-downs themselves are fairly easy. The fourth involves a fight with three thugs. Running out of time will fail the mission. The second half of this mission is a hostage rescue.

side:22.text: Each recording will result in a reward of 50 XP upon being found. After acquiring all nine recordings—three in Financial District, two in Chinatown, two in Greenwich, and two in Midtown—the side mission Scales of Justice is unlocked, which awards 1500 XP upon completion.

boss:2.text: In the game, Shocker appears as a boss battle when he was hired by Martin Li to rob a bank for the Inner Demons. In Marvel's Spider-Man 2, he was mentioned as one of the supervillains sought out by Kraven the Hunter. Herman was born in New York City around the year 1976.
